scope: Userspace 48 kHz mono/stereo speaker playback and native Qt ALSA controls
hardware_base: qualified ram97; exact kernel sources, board.dtb and hardware config unchanged
alsa: Pinned unmodified ALSA lib and aplay. plug linear resampler 48k->96k, stereo averaged to HFR slot 3; first 3 slots silent.
qt: Native mixer readback. Volume maps 0..100 to HFR gain 0..24; zero or mute disables right route. Nonblocking worker with explicit period1024 and buffer4096 app frames. 30-second bounded -24dBFS signal.
failure_preserved: ram98 snd_pcm_set_params period-time ambiguity; fixed over RAM SSH without a kernel reboot or display reset. App clean exit restored original mixer.
offline: Real ARM ALSA chain six input cases through file/null sink under QEMU. Qt start/clean exit. Exact setup function also tested in QEMU.
live: Owner heard corrected app and confirmed volume/mute. Front up/down hold and mute events verified with independent mixer and hardware PCM observations. Final repeatable image has same app hash.
recovery: One-use p8 factory-restore-before-handoff, read-only/unmounted RAM eMMC, unchanged watchdog helper, verified hardware expiry back to stock
display: No display reset cycles or unrelated display calibration/restart checks
